title: Notion-backed self-healing loop policy
description: Bounds for the loop that selects issues from the operator's DCA Issues database, dispatches one repair branch each, reads the outcome back, and reopens a repaired issue whose error code recurs. Kept separate from self_heal.json so the bounded self-heal policy is not widened by this loop's own caps.

$schema.description: Pins this document to the strict local draft-07 schema instead of relying on an editor-selected policy.

enabled.description: Operator kill switch for the repair half. The shipped false default requires an explicit operator edit before the loop can open anything against a repository that drives live trading.

max_repairs_per_tick.description: Most dispatches one tick may plan. The ceiling bounds how many unreviewed changes a single unattended run can put in front of a reviewer.

max_attempts_per_issue.description: Attempts charged at dispatch before an issue quarantines. Reaching it is terminal, so a recurring defect cannot consume repair capacity forever.

breaker_refused_threshold.description: Rows sitting in the Refused state that latch the breaker. The refused queue is the latch, so only a human triaging those rows clears it.

review_lease_days.description: Days a dispatched attempt may remain unsettled before it is refused, so an ignored proposal cannot hold an issue's only slot indefinitely.

max_prs_per_month.description: Pull requests the loop may open in a calendar month. Each dispatch costs a full CI fan-out, measured at roughly 34 job-minutes across the twelve jobs, so this is the ceiling that makes the loop's spend bounded rather than open-ended.

max_prs_per_day.description: Pull requests the loop may open in one day, mirroring config/self_heal.json's max_repairs_per_day. Separate from the per-tick cap because a per-tick cap only equals a per-day cap while the schedule fires exactly once a day; a manual re-fire or a retry breaks that equivalence.

quiet_logged_days.description: Logged Run Log days without a recurrence before an open issue is treated as handled outside the loop. Counted in logged days rather than calendar days, so the Run Log's weekend gaps cannot read as health.
